content_sections.heading: About CMOH Purulia
content_sections.text: The Office of the Chief Medical Officer of Health (CMOH), Purulia works under the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, from the Zilla Swasthya Bhawan Campus, Ranchi Road, Purulia. The CMOH is also the Secretary of the District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia, and this recruitment is for contractual posts under the National Health Mission for that Samiti. The notice is signed by Dr. Asok Biswas, CMOH & Secretary, District Health and Family Welfare Samiti, Purulia.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice lists 108 posts in four categories of posts. The category-wise break-up for each post is given below exactly as printed.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: Every post requires the candidate to be a permanent resident of West Bengal and able to read, write and speak Bengali. The notice states that the prescribed conditions are non-relaxable. Essential: Permanent resident of West Bengal. Able to read, write and speak Bengali. BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognised by the respective council. Completed compulsory internship. Registration Certificate of the Respective Council should be obtained. BHMS qualification must be included in the Second Schedule of the Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973. Candidates must be registered either in Part-A of the State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners maintained by the Council of Homoeopathic Medicine, West Bengal or in Part I of the Central Register maintained by Central Council of Homoeopathy. BHMS will include Graded BHMS degree also. Desirable: MD in Homoeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani from a recognised institution. Essential: Permanent resident of West Bengal. Able to read, write and speak Bengali. BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognised by the respective council. Completed compulsory internship. Registration Certificate of the Respective Council should be obtained. BHMS qualification must be included in the Second Schedule of the Homoeopathy Central Council Act, 1973. Candidates must be registered either in Part-A of the State Register of Homoeopathic Medical Practitioners maintained by the Council of Homoeopathic Medicine, West Bengal or in Part I of the Central Register maintained by Central Council of Homoeopathy. BHMS will include Graded BHMS degree also. Desirable: MD in Homoeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani from a recognised institution. Essential: The candidate should be permanent resident of West Bengal and should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali. Two years Diploma in Pharmacy (D-Pharma) (ALLOPATHIC) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI)/AICTE. Registration certificate issued by West Bengal Pharmacy Council. Desirable: Persons holding Bachelor in Pharmacy (B-Pharma) and Masters in Pharmacy (M-Pharma) from any institute approved by Pharmacy Council of India (PCI) / AICTE will be given additional marks. Essential: The candidate should be permanent resident of West Bengal and should be able to read, write and speak in Bengali. Completed GNM training course from an institute recognised by Indian Nursing council. Registration certificate issued by West Bengal Nursing Council. Desirable: Persons with clinical experience in Government/Private hospitals. The age limit is counted as on 01.04.2026 for every post. Age relaxation for reserved categories is admissible as per the prevailing rules/orders of the Government of West Bengal. The benefit applies only to candidates belonging to the categories for which such relaxation is permissible under the prevailing Government rules. The notice does not print the number of years of relaxation for each category. Candidates should check the official notification

content_sections.heading: Selection Process and Marks
content_sections.text: The selection process will be conducted by the District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), Purulia. For each post, the notice's "Mode of Selection" gives a marking scheme of Total Marks 100, based on the percentage obtained in each examination (proportionate marking). Selected candidates' candidature remains provisional until all original documents are verified and all eligibility conditions are met. Experience scoring for Staff Nurse – RBSK: Completed one year but less than 2 years – 5 marks Two completed years but less than 3 years – 10 marks Three completed years but less than 4 years – 15 marks Four completed years and above – 20 marks The general conditions of the notice also refer to a list of candidates called for Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification, and to a Computer Test, Written Test and Interview for the purpose of TA/DA; the notice does not give details or dates of any such test or interview.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The engagement to these posts is purely contractual and temporary in nature. The notice does not mention the length of the contract or any allowances on top of the consolidated remuneration. Selected candidates may be posted at any health facility/institution/unit under the administrative control of the District AYUSH Samity/District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, as decided by the competent authority. No claim for posting at a particular place will be entertained. No TA/DA is admissible for appearing in the Computer Test, Written Test, Interview, Document Verification or any other stage of the recruitment process. The District Health & Family Welfare Samiti reserves the right to cancel the recruitment process at any stage without assigning any reason.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Applications are accepted online only. The application window is open as of 19 November 2026. Go to www.wbhealth.gov.in and open Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment. Complete the online registration by 2 December 2026, the last date of online registration. Submit the online application between 19 November 2026 (10:00 hrs) and 3 December 2026. Submit only one online application for a particular post; a candidate may apply for more than one post if he/she fulfils the eligibility criteria for each post. Check every entry before final submission, because no request for modification/correction is entertained once the application is finally submitted. Do not send any physical documents to the office; documents are checked only at document verification.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: At document verification, applicants must be present in person with the original copies of all testimonials and all original documents supporting every claim made in the online application, along with one set of self-attested copies. The documents named in the notice are: Online-generated application form, duly signed by the candidate, with one recent passport-size photograph pasted on it Madhyamik (or equivalent) Admit Card/Certificate as proof of age All relevant mark sheets and pass certificates Valid EWS certificate issued by the competent authority, wherever applicable Voter ID/Aadhaar Card/any other valid address proof All relevant experience certificates, along with salary slips for the last three months against each claimed period of experience Caste certificate issued by the competent authority of the Government of West Bengal, wherever applicable Failure to produce any requisite document may result in cancellation of candidature. Applicants may also be required to submit any other documents desired by the District Level Selection Committee (DLSC), for which prior notice will be given.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Submitting more than one application for the same post cancels all applications submitted for that post, and no further correspondence is entertained. The experience certificate must clearly mention the duration of experience, post held, nature of work and the employer's signature with date; otherwise it will be treated as invalid. Where DGPA/CGPA or Grade Point is awarded, the corresponding conversion formula must be attached. Incomplete online applications are liable to result in cancellation of candidature. Any omission or suppression of information will result in rejection of the application or cancellation of candidature at any stage without further intimation. If any information is found false, incorrect or misleading, or any document forged/fabricated, at any stage or during engagement, the candidature/engagement will be cancelled forthwith, without prejudice to other action under the applicable rules/law. Inclusion of a name in the list of candidates called for Computer Test/Interview/Document Verification does not confer any right to appointment. Updates on the recruitment process will appear on the official website of the Department of Health & Family Welfare, Government of West Bengal, and the concerned district website. The office email printed on the notice is [email protected] .

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 108 posts: 36 Medical Officer – AYUSH (MHT) Male, 32 Medical Officer – AYUSH (MHT) Female, 38 Pharmacist – RBSK and 2 Staff Nurse – RBSK.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The online application window runs from 19 November 2026 (10:00 hrs) to 3 December 2026, but the last date of online registration is 2 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for Medical Officer – AYUSH (MHT)?
faq.answer: A BHMS/BAMS/BUMS degree from an institution recognised by the respective council, completed compulsory internship and the registration certificate of the respective council; MD in Homoeopathy/Ayurvedic/Unani is desirable.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the CMOH Purulia posts?
faq.answer: Medical Officer – AYUSH (MHT) and Staff Nurse – RBSK have a maximum of 40 years, and Pharmacist – RBSK requires a minimum age of 18 years but not exceeding 40 years, all as on 01.04.2026. Reserved categories get relaxation as per West Bengal Government rules.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for these posts?
faq.answer: The consolidated remuneration is Rs. 32,000/- per month for Medical Officer – AYUSH (MHT), Rs. 22,000/- for Pharmacist – RBSK and Rs.25,000/- for Staff Nurse – RBSK.

faq.question: Q6. How do I apply for CMOH Purulia Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online only at www.wbhealth.gov.in under Quick links → Career, Education & Recruitment → Online Recruitment; no physical documents are to be sent to the office.

faq.question: Q7. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: The District Level Selection Committee, Purulia conducts the selection using a 100-mark scheme based on Class 10, Class 12 and professional qualification marks, plus additional qualifications or, for Staff Nurse – RBSK, clinical experience, followed by verification of original documents.

faq.question: Q8. Can I apply for more than one post?
faq.answer: Yes, a candidate may apply for more than one post if he/she fulfils the eligibility for each, but only one application is allowed per post; duplicate applications for the same post cancel all of them.

faq.question: Q9. Is the CMOH Purulia job permanent?
faq.answer: No, the engagement is purely contractual and temporary in nature, under the National Health Mission for the District Health & Family Welfare Samity, Purulia.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates from outside West Bengal apply?
faq.answer: No, applicants must be permanent residents of West Bengal and must be able to read, write and speak Bengali.
